decisions.reason: Identifies PID 42432 dsh web host as koffi.node holder; explains LoadLibrary image mapping keeps the file locked until that process exits, so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY.
Explains refresh only replaces the renderer document while the host keeps its PID and mapped images; gives ordered stop/verify-lock, external install, verify, restart procedure.
Explains bare spec equals @latest=0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha=0.1.2-alpha.5, a silent downgrade over alpha.4; explicitly refutes 'keep current' and 'newest' misconceptions.
Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 and pinned separate TUI install after stopping host, verifies dsh --version, restarts; tags discussed only as inferior alternatives.
Rules tell README authors to pin the exact tested core version, never bundle unpinned host+plugin installs, and state that latest may be older than the installed prerelease.
